companyNames.description: Only return jobs from these companies. Empty = all companies.
companyNames.title: Companies (whitelist)

dateFetchedPastNDays.description: Only include jobs fetched within the last N days.
dateFetchedPastNDays.title: Posted Within (days)

excludedCompanyKeywords.description: Substring match on company name; exclude these.
excludedCompanyKeywords.title: Excluded company keywords

industries.description: Filter to companies in these industries.
industries.title: Industries

jobDescriptionQuery.description: Filter to jobs whose DESCRIPTION contains this phrase.
jobDescriptionQuery.title: Job description contains

jobTitleQuery.description: Filter to jobs whose TITLE contains this phrase. More precise than the general search query.
jobTitleQuery.title: Job title contains

locations.description: Filter to jobs in these locations. Pass plain strings like ["San Francisco", "London", "United States"] OR objects with {label, value, countryCode, stateCode, city, lat, lng}. Empty list = global (all locations). Hiring.cafe matches both city names and country names.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to return across all queries.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxYearsExperience.description: Filter to jobs requiring at most this many years experience.
maxYearsExperience.title: Maximum years of experience

minSalary.description: Lower bound for compensation. Combined with currency + frequency.
minSalary.title: Minimum salary

minYearsExperience.description: Filter to jobs requiring at least this many years experience.
minYearsExperience.title: Minimum years of experience

onlyTransparentSalaries.description: Exclude jobs that dont publish a salary range.
onlyTransparentSalaries.title: Only transparent salaries

salaryCurrency.description: Filter salary thresholds against this currency. Empty = any.
salaryCurrency.title: Salary currency

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search on hiring.cafe (e.g., 'software engineer', 'data scientist'). Empty array or empty string returns unfiltered results.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

securityClearances.description: Filter by clearance level. Empty = all jobs.
securityClearances.title: Security clearances

technologyKeywordsQuery.description: Match against the parsed tech-stack tags (e.g. python, react, kubernetes).
technologyKeywordsQuery.title: Technology keywords

workplaceTypes.description: Filter by workplace type. Defaults to all three.
workplaceTypes.title: Workplace Types
